+        # Interactive selection helper using fzf and CD behavior
+        def fzf_available?
+          begin
+            which = `which fzf 2>/dev/null`.strip
+            !which.empty?
+          rescue
+            false
+          end
+        end
+
+        def fzf_select(lines)
+          return nil if lines.nil? || lines.empty?
+          return nil unless fzf_available?
+
+          selection = nil
+          begin
+            IO.popen('fzf --ansi --no-sort', 'r+') do |io|
+              io.puts(lines.join("\n"))
+              io.close_write
+              selection = io.read
+            end
+          rescue Errno::ENOENT
+            return nil
+          end
+          selection && !selection.strip.empty? ? selection.strip : nil
+        end
+
+        # If --interactive was requested, run fzf on the plain path list
+        if options[:interactive]
+          plain_lines = data_rows.map do |r|
+            if r['type'] == 'd'
+              r['path'].end_with?('/') ? r['path'] : (r['path'] + '/')
+            else
+              r['path']
+            end
+          end
+
+          if !fzf_available?
+            STDERR.puts "fzf not found in PATH; please install fzf to use --interactive"
+            # fall through to normal output
+          else
+            sel = fzf_select(plain_lines)
+            if sel.nil? || sel.empty?
+              # User cancelled or no selection
+              return
+            end
+
+            puts sel
+            return
+          end
+        end
+
+        # If --cd was requested without --interactive, print the top result and exit
+        if options[:cd]
+          first = data_rows.first
+          if first
+            sel_path = first['path']
+            puts sel_path
+            return
+          else
+            puts "No results found."
+            return
+          end
+        end
+
+        palette = Histlog::Config.colors(:paths)
+        exec_col = palette[:exec]
+        args_col = palette[:args]
+        dir_path_col = palette[:dir_path]
+        reset_col = palette[:reset]
+
+        begin
+          printf("%s%6s%s %s%6s%s %s\n", exec_col, "Exec", reset_col, args_col, "Args", reset_col, "Path")
+          puts "-------------------------"
+        rescue Errno::EPIPE
+          return
+        end
+
+        data_rows.each do |row|
+          exec_count = row['exec'].to_i
+          args_count = row['args'].to_i
+          exec_str = exec_count.to_s.rjust(6)
+          args_str = args_count.to_s.rjust(6)
+
+          display_path = if row['type'] == 'd'
+                           if row['path'] == '/'
+                             "#{dir_path_col}/#{reset_col}"
+                           else
+                             base = row['path'].end_with?('/') ? row['path'].chomp('/') : row['path']
+                             "#{dir_path_col}#{base}#{reset_col}/"
+                           end
+                         else
+                           row['path']
+                         end
+
+          begin
+            puts "#{exec_col}#{exec_str}#{reset_col} #{args_col}#{args_str}#{reset_col} #{display_path}"
+          rescue Errno::EPIPE
+            return
+          end
+        end
       ensure
         db&.close
       end
